author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Rebuilt from scratch to match the live app (this repo's manifest.json had the wrong appId entirely — pointing at an unregistered app, not the real Conference Lead Form — and the code itself was a completely different concept, a lead management board instead of the mobile capture form actually in use). Now a single-page, mobile-first lead-capture form: First Name*, Last Name, Email*, Company, Industry, Product Family, Buying Stage, Conference, Notes, Business Card upload, Submit. Also fixed the Conference dropdown's backing insight, which only listed one user as a member — it would have come up empty for anyone else staffing a booth.
